blocks.s: From Ruysbroeck: whenever God opens himself to the spirit as an unfathomable abyss — high as heaven, deep as hell, long as the earth, broader than the sea (cf. Job 11:8-9) — the contemplating spirit perceives itself, in this manifestation, supernaturally sublimated, extended, and made deiform; and perceiving this, it acknowledges God's grace, and seeing God as incomparably more unshakeable, approaches his contemplation with fear, reverence, and sobriety.
